_description: Face Region Extraction Stage - Step 4 of the FaceMed AI Pipeline
description: After validation, the AI extracts only the clinically relevant facial skin regions. Background elements (walls, clothing, furniture) are excluded to focus analysis on actual skin pixels.

extractedRegions.name: forehead
extractedRegions.clinicalRelevance: Primary zone for oiliness, acne, and pore size evaluation

extractedRegions.name: leftCheek
extractedRegions.clinicalRelevance: Hydration level, redness, pigmentation and erythema analysis

extractedRegions.name: rightCheek
extractedRegions.clinicalRelevance: Hydration level, redness, pigmentation and erythema analysis

extractedRegions.name: nose
extractedRegions.clinicalRelevance: Sebum secretion, blackhead visibility and pore dilation

extractedRegions.name: chin
extractedRegions.clinicalRelevance: Hormonal acne spots and skin dryness

implementation: The canvas captures a 64x64 pixel crop of the skin region from the HTML5 Canvas element. The full face canvas is used as input and skin-only regions are weighted higher in the CNN feature maps via learned filters.
